name: 源流福爾摩沙
english_description: A Taiwan-history exploration MUD (源流福爾摩沙) by wade-fs. New characters pick a language, id, password, nickname, race, and nature; the first player names the mud and becomes god, then starts in 民雄鄉 (Minxiong / 打貓社), a Chiayi township built as layered historical sites rather than square rooms. Play is Traditional Chinese (look/info/quit); travel uses place names (民雄車站, 大士爺廟, 甘蔗田). No MySQL required.
